document.abstract: This paper explains the process of VPN detection and blocking at both the OTT interface and CDN level, and gives examples of how it is used to stop the abuse of premium VPNs that are using hijacked residential IP addresses to circumvent the territorial rights licensing of content owners and rights holders. It will also provide information on new techniques for geolocation spoofing and discuss ways to thwart them.
